name: Corpus Delicti
description: Dive into the atmospheric sounds of post-punk with a live performance from the influential band Corpus Delicti.
longDescription:
Corpus Delicti, the French post-punk band, performs live at Auditório CCOP on May 2, 2026. Formed in 1991, the group is recognized for its contributions to the European gothic rock and post-punk scenes, releasing several albums throughout the 1990s and reuniting for select performances in recent years. Their sound is characterized by a blend of melancholic melodies, driving rhythms, and atmospheric textures.

Attendees can expect a concert experience focused on the band's distinctive sound. The Auditório CCOP provides an indoor setting for the performance. The event is categorized as music, indicating a focus on the live musical presentation. The duration of the performance is typical for a concert.

Tickets are required for entry. Further details regarding ticket purchase and availability will be announced closer to the event date. The Auditório CCOP is located in Porto. Specific public transport routes and accessibility information are not provided at this time.
